project_type: React + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS SPA with Node.js/Express backend (server.js)
language: TypeScript (strict mode, noEmit: true, moduleResolution: bundler)
build_system: npm: tsc (type-check only) + vite build. Build command is: npm run build (= tsc && vite build). Server: node server.js on port 3001.
verification_instructions: Run `npm run build` from `c:\Users\LENOVO\Downloads\voice agent dashboard`. Must exit 0 with no TypeScript errors. Then confirm routes/proxy/nav exist as specified.
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/ folder produced by `npm run build`. Never commit dist/. calls.json is auto-generated by server at runtime.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell. Project root: c:\Users\LENOVO\Downloads\voice agent dashboard. All file paths must be absolute or explicitly relative to that root. Do NOT restart the running server during implementation.
contribution_requirements: Do NOT change any existing Sarvam API calls, hooks, pages, or server routes (except OverviewPage additions and server.js SetSmart proxy block addition). Only ADD new files and update: src/config.ts, .env, server.js (add proxy block), src/components/Layout.tsx (nav), src/App.tsx (routes), src/pages/OverviewPage.tsx (add WhatsApp section at bottom).
key_patterns: 1) API clients: axios.create({ baseURL }) pattern in src/api/sarvamClient.ts — clone for setsmartClient.ts. 2) API functions: named exports like fetchX(), use sarvamClient.get/post, return typed Promise<T>. 3) React Query hooks: useQuery({ queryKey: ['key', params], queryFn, refetchInterval: N, refetchIntervalInBackground: true, staleTime: 0, gcTime: 120000 }) pattern from useInteractions.ts. 4) Pages: functional components, `export function XPage()`, space-y-6 wrapper div, h1 text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900 heading. 5) Cards: `bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 shadow-card p-5`. 6) Active nav: `bg-green-500 text-white`; inactive: `text-gray-600 hover:bg-green-50 hover:text-green-700`. 7) Theme: bg-[#e8f5e9] outer, white rounded-3xl inner, #4CAF50 accent. 8) StatCard component at src/components/StatCard.tsx — reuse for KPI tiles. 9) recharts (BarChart, LineChart, PieChart, ResponsiveContainer etc.) already installed. 10) lucide-react already installed. 11) date-fns already installed. 12) Layout uses navItems array + otherItems array rendered as NavLink components.
directory_structure: root: server.js, package.json, tsconfig.json, tailwind.config.js, .env, calls.json (runtime), dist/ (build output). src/: App.tsx, main.tsx, index.css. src/api/: sarvamClient.ts, interactions.ts, attempts.ts, campaigns.ts, boards.ts, recordings.ts, transcripts.ts, traces.ts, webhookCalls.ts. src/hooks/: useInteractions.ts, useAttempts.ts, useCampaigns.ts, useBoards.ts, useRecording.ts, useTranscript.ts, useTrace.ts, useWebhookCalls.ts, useWebhookStream.ts. src/types/: index.ts. src/components/: Layout.tsx, StatCard.tsx, CallsTable.tsx, TranscriptPanel.tsx, DateRangePicker.tsx, charts/CallsPerDayChart.tsx, charts/EndReasonChart.tsx, charts/GoalStatusChart.tsx. src/pages/: OverviewPage.tsx, CallsPage.tsx, AttemptsPage.tsx, AnalyticsPage.tsx, CampaignsPage.tsx, GroupByPage.tsx, BoardsPage.tsx, SettingsPage.tsx, WebhookCallsPage.tsx. src/utils/: dateUtils.ts.
